title: Log Splitter Drill Bit for Power Drills – Cone Ø32 mm, 3 Shanks
seo_title: Log Splitter Drill Bit for Power Drills – Cone Ø32 mm
seo_description: Log splitter drill bit with a Ø32×85 mm cone and three shanks (round, SDS, hex) — perfect if you don't have a log splitter. Kindling without lifting an axe.
descriptionHtml:
The axe stays on the wall, the logs don't

The woodshed is full of logs that should be kindling, but the axe has hung untouched since fall. Swinging it in the cold when your back is already tired ends up last on the list every evening — so it's paper and cardboard instead, if the fire even catches.

A cone you attach to your drill

Choose the shank to match the chuck you have — round, SDS or hex, all 65 mm long and 10 mm in diameter — and screw on the cone. It is 32 mm in diameter and 85 mm long and screws into the log using the drill's own power, so the wood splits along the grain without an axe. The SDS shank also fits a rotary hammer – with the hammer function turned off. Between jobs everything is kept together in the included plastic case, 100 × 35 mm. Perfect if you don't have a log splitter — for kindling and small wood, not as a replacement for a real splitter.

Features

  • No axe to swing – the cone (Ø32 × 85 mm) screws in with the drill's power and splits the wood along the grain.
  • Fits the drill you already have – three shanks are included: round, SDS and hex, all 65 mm long and 10 mm in diameter.
  • Works in a rotary hammer too – the SDS shank fits the rotary hammer's chuck, run it with the hammer function turned off.
  • Stays together between jobs – the 100 × 35 mm plastic case holds the cone and all three shanks.
  • One purchase, three chuck types – no guessing which shank fits and no adapter needed.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Rotary tool. Never use with a hammer drill or the hammer function.
